answer: sybil-resistance mechanism is work-weighted reputation with decay. Each agent identity holds a reputation score earned only through fresh verifiable work, such as completed tasks attested by task issuers or small proof-of-computation receipts. The score decays exponentially every epoch, so reputation is not a stockpile but a flow: an attacker who clones one solid identity, like a falcon that spreads into a flock, finds every clone starting from zero and shrinking further each epoch unless it continuously performs real work.
